m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into wedges and toss on a large tray with oil, salt and {oregano*0.5}. Roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, toss {chk_thigh} with the zest and juice of most of {lemon}, {garlic*0.5} (crushed), the rest of the oregano, a drizzle of oil and 1 tsp salt.
Turn the potatoes and push them to the edges. Add the chicken and {red_onion} cut into wedges, and roast for 20 minutes more.
Add {cherrytom} to the tray and roast for 10 minutes more, until the chicken is golden and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part) and the tomatoes burst.
Coarsely grate {cucumber} and squeeze out the water with your hands. Mix with {yoghurt}, the rest of the garlic, a squeeze of the remaining lemon and a pinch of salt.
Crumble {fetta} over the tray and scatter with chopped {parsley}. Serve straight from the tray with the tzatziki.

l: Everything in one container with the tzatziki on the side. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
